description: A newer-run guard that runs only after the image is published is rejected.

patches.find:
[ "$(resolve_digest "$login_server/$repository@$digest")" = "$digest" ] \
  || saf_die "the registry does not resolve the image digest"
patches.replace:
[ "$(resolve_digest "$login_server/$repository@$digest")" = "$digest" ] \
  || saf_die "the registry does not resolve the image digest"
if saf_newer_run_deployed; then exit 0; fi
